kamloops.title: RCMP thought she died of a cardiac arrest. Now, they say her death was suspicious
kamloops.description: Police are looking for information about the death of 30-year-old Danya Monk of Fort St. James, B.C. after an autopsy revealed she died under suspicious circumstances and not a cardiac arrest, as originally believed.

prince-george.title: Investigation into fatal plane crash in Prince George could take up to 450 days: TSB
prince-george.description: So far, the only information about the incident's cause released by the Transportation Safety Board is that the plane lost power to a single engine, prompting it to come down. However, aviation experts have pointed out that model of plane is supposed to be able to fly on just one of its two engines.

southeast.title: IIO investigating after youth jumps from roof of B.C. school after fleeing police
southeast.description: RCMP say the incident began when they were called to a Cranbrook home for a report of a youth male who had allegedly "threatened individuals at the residence with a knife."

southeast.title: String of Highway 1 crashes near Revelstoke prompt calls for enforcement, improvements
southeast.description: Leaders and residents from the Revelstoke region are calling for improvements to a section of the Trans Canada Highway, following a string of fatal collisions and prolonged closures.
